beats: Hook (the addition example, Q24-04 07:34-08:30): a jar holding six marbles could have come from bowls of 2 and 4, 3 and 3 or 1 and 5; looking at the jar you cannot tell, so a machine that adds cannot run backwards. Every quantum gate must. So how does a quantum computer add? (line_qc_undo_marble_jar; code letters the three splits.) Cast for lecture Q25-05 (QC05-01 to QC05-04): the tinkerer (bob with a fringe, work apron) works the machines; the skeptic (tall, beanie, long scarf) checks them.
Gates are unitary matrices: a postulate of the theory that experiments keep confirming (Q25-05 01:22-03:18; reuse line_tiny_lab).

Norm preserving: a unitary turns the state's arrow without stretching it, so valid state in, valid state out and the probabilities still add to 1 (03:43-05:06; line_qc_undo_pivot_arrow: the arrow swings, the tape measure says the same length; or reuse line_clock_face with a code-drawn hand).
Reversible: U^-1 = U-dagger, so every gate can be undone and no information is destroyed (05:26-06:54, clip 05:34-06:01; line_qc_undo_twist_cube: every twist has an untwist).
Lost information is only unknown information (Q24-04 05:08-06:09): the key is still somewhere in the leaves, we just do not know where (line_qc_undo_leaf_pile).

AND is not reversible: a dark bulb could come from three switch settings, so AND is not a quantum gate (06:01-06:54, clip; line_qc_undo_and_bulb; code letters the four-row truth table and rings the three rows that give 0).

The fix: keep one addend, (a, b) -> (a, a + b): the jar plus a tag saying what the first bowl held runs backwards (Q24-04 07:34-08:30, clip; line_qc_undo_jar_tag). Pays off in QC05-06: the Toffoli gate is a reversible AND.

Tool for later, brief: a normal matrix splits into eigen-parts (spectral decomposition); to apply f(A), apply f to each eigenvalue and put the parts back (07:27-12:27; line_qc_undo_two_prisms: split the beam, treat each ray, recombine). QC05-03 uses it to build rotations. Caption the prisms as a picture of the recipe, not of physics.
Cover (line_cover_qc05_01; for the X post and thumbnails, not a film beat): the skeptic squints through a magnifying glass at a jar of marbles beside two empty bowls; the tinkerer shrugs.
